description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing and caching application data related to users and sessions. It includes hooks for consuming the context and handles initial data loading, error states, and refresh functions.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Hook to access the shared DataContext providing users and sessions data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that loads and caches users and sessions data on mount, providing context values and refresh functions.
